models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: v5-equivalent predicted from AA's own published v5 component scores (AutomationBench, Terminal-Bench 4.0, HLE-Diamond, GDP.pdf, AA-Briefcase) via linear fit on 90 models with an official v5 index (RMSE 1.7 pts); predicted 27.7 (legacy-component fit 26.8). AA lists the components but no official v5 index for this model (v4.3 score 40). Treat as about equal to GLM-5.3-Flash (27.8) and below DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (32.5 max / 28.5 high).
models.notes: Released 2026-08-24. 125B backbone (512 experts, top-10, 6B active) + 51B n-gram embedding table (one row read per token, can stay mmapped on SSD/RAM and never needs VRAM) + 4B MTP. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Qwen Sparse Attention: only 12 of 48 layers keep a KV cache, so 256K context costs about 6.3GB at F16 KV and 3.2GB at q8_0. The GSQ-RCO IQ3_S file (83.6GB) is the best quality that leaves room for full context on a 96GB box; IQ3_XXS (75.8GB) leaves more headroom. llama.cpp qwen4exp arch merged 2026-08-27. Vision needs the repo's mmproj file.

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B
models.score_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (artificialanalysis.ai leaderboard JSON, fetched 2026-11-02); AA model page shows 14 when rounded (accessed 2026-11-06).
models.notes: Released 2026-10-12. Hybrid Mamba2/MoE: 40 Mamba + 40 MoE (512 experts, top-22) + 8 attention blocks, so the KV cache is tiny and the full 1M context is practical at 96GB. Best US-origin open model in this tier; vision input; MTP draft published by ggml-org. Q4_K_XL (86.9GB) is the quality pick and Q3_K_XL (65.8GB) leaves 30GB for long context and batch.

models.name: Step 3.7 Flash
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: no official AA v5 index. Predicted from AA's published legacy components (SciCode 43.9%, CritPt 2.3%) via linear fit on 98 models with an official v5 index (RMSE 5.5 pts) -> 11.4; other AA components point the same way (Terminal-Bench Hard 35.6%, tau2 98.5%, IFBench 67.3%, GPQA 80.9%). Treat as 11 +/- 5 until AA publishes an index.
models.notes: Released 2026-05-29. 198B language backbone + 1.8B vision encoder, 288 experts top-8, about 11B active. Only 12 of 45 layers are full attention; the other 33 use a 512-token sliding window, so KV is small for a 200B model. UD-IQ3_S (80.0GB) is the safe fit with room for 256K; UD-Q3_K_M (89.3GB) is a quality step up but leaves only about 6GB for KV and compute at 96GB. Vision needs the repo's mmproj-F16.gguf (0.9GB).

models.name: Qwen3 Coder Next
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: no official AA v5 index. Predicted from AA's published v5 components (AutomationBench 1%, Terminal-Bench 4.0 0%, GDP.pdf 2.6%, AA-Briefcase 404 Elo) via linear fit on 107 models with an official v5 index (RMSE 3.0 pts) -> 5.3. The low AA-Briefcase score drags the general index down; for coding agents the model is stronger than that. Legacy-component fit gives 6.9.
models.notes: Released 2026-02-03. Coding-agent specialist: 512 experts, top-10, 3B active, hybrid Gated DeltaNet with 12 full-attention layers out of 48, 256K native context, non-thinking only. At 96GB this is the one model that runs at Q8_0 (84.8GB) with full precision weights and still leaves about 11GB for context, so it is the pick when a 96GB box is a coding box and quant loss matters.

models.name: Mistral Medium 3.5 128B
models.score_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (artificialanalysis.ai, fetched 2026-11-06): 4.65.
models.notes: Released 2026-04-29. Dense 128B, unified instruct/reasoning/coding with per-request reasoning effort, multimodal input, 256K context. The only dense model in this tier: decode is steadier than MoE on unified memory, but 88 full-attention layers cost about 352KB/token at F16 KV, so the UD-Q4_K_XL file (75.7GB) leaves room for about 32K context on 96GB and Q5_K_M (88.3GB) only about 8K. Vision needs mmproj-F16.gguf (1.0GB). Licence has a revenue cap.
